items.exampleEn: Handle these glass cups with caution.
The fans were enthusiastic about the new singer.
items.exampleZh: 歌迷們對新歌手非常熱情。

items.exampleEn: Nothing could tempt him to leave his hometown.
items.exampleZh: 沒有什麼能誘使他離開家鄉。

items.exampleEn: His compliment made her smile all day.
items.exampleZh: 他的讚美讓她開心了一整天。

items.exampleEn: It irritates me when people are late for meetings.
items.exampleZh: 有人開會遲到，我就很煩。

items.exampleEn: It was careless of me to leave the door open.
She is old, but she is young in spirit.
items.exampleZh: 她年紀大了，但精神上依然年輕。

items.sentenceEn: Careless mistakes can cost a lot of money.
items.sentenceZh: 粗心的錯誤可能會讓人損失很多錢。

items.audioEn: I'm sorry, but the noise from the street really irritates me tonight.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，今晚街上的噪音真的讓我很煩。

items.sentenceEn: Everyone was in good spirits after the holiday.
items.sentenceZh: 放完假後大家心情都很好。

items.sentenceEn: This is a serious problem, so we need to act now.
items.sentenceZh: 這是個嚴重的問題，所以我們必須現在就行動。

items.stemEn: My boss rarely gives anyone a ____, so I was very happy.
items.stemZh: 我老闆很少稱讚別人，所以我很開心。

items.stemEn: He made a ____ mistake and sent the email to the wrong person.
items.stemZh: 他犯了個粗心的錯，把郵件寄給了錯的人。

items.passageEn: Our school's sports day is always full of spirit. This year, the students were enthusiastic, and the teachers joined the races too. The weather was hot, so the coach told everyone to run with caution. One careless runner fell, but luckily it was not serious. Food stands tempted the children with ice cream. Some loud music irritated a few parents, but most people had fun. At the end, the head of the school gave every class a compliment on their teamwork.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的運動會總是充滿活力。今年學生們很熱情，老師們也一起參加賽跑。天氣很熱，所以教練要大家小心跑。有一位粗心的跑者跌倒了，幸好不嚴重。小吃攤用冰淇淋吸引孩子們。有些大聲的音樂讓幾位家長很煩，但大多數人都玩得很開心。最後，校長稱讚每一班的團隊合作。

questions.questionZh: 那位粗心的跑者怎麼了？
什麼讓一些家長覺得很煩？

rubricZh: 「謝謝⋯」可寫 Thank you for…、Thanks for… 等
寫 Thank you for saying that. 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 我哥哥對他的新工作很認真。
referenceEn: My brother is very serious about his new job.
My older brother is really serious about his new job.
rubricZh: 用 be serious about 表示「認真看待」（例如 is very serious about…；寫 takes … seriously 也正確）
